blocks.text: LOS ANGELES — Tom Cruise is being celebrated with a life achievement award from the American Film Institute, AFI’s board of trustees said Wednesday, Oct. 21. The award will be handed out at a gala tribute in Los Angeles at the Dolby Theatre on April 24 next year. “Tom Cruise is a global icon,” said Kathleen Kennedy, chair of AFI’s board of trustees, in a statement. She praised Cruise’s commitment as an actor and producer and his belief in movies’ ability to bring people together.
